svg.title: 按空间采样率着色的运行轨迹

cc:Work.dc:title: 按空间采样率着色的运行轨迹
cc:Work.dc:description: 后端可信 map 系轨迹按窗口结束时刻就近关联；颜色表示该窗口的指标。Trusted backend map-frame IMU positions nearest each window end, within 30 ms and same epoch. No GT, fitted transform or time offset used.
